label: r2c1
name: mirror + 2 PPO epochs
hypothesis: Same network and recipe as r1c2, but with ppo_epochs set to 2. The budget then allows about 227k steps (about 110 updates) instead of about 158k. r1c2's training success was still rising when training stopped, so more fresh designs should help more than reusing each sample a third time. Refuted if dev success falls below 0.86, meaning the third epoch mattered more than the extra samples.
last_analysis: Joining the trunk features with their left-right flip is what made the task learnable (0 to about 0.9). On the recipe side, 128 envs and 2 PPO epochs give the best result (r2c1, 0.919). Recipes that push for more, smaller updates (1 epoch; 64 envs) collapsed to pressing DONE straight away, scoring 0 on both seeds. Collapse to DONE is the main risk. A deeper trunk and global context in the head did not help. Gamma 0.99 gave the best single seed (0.953) but its two seeds were far apart (0.95 and 0.79). This last round keeps r2c1's sample budget and tries to make training less likely to collapse: orthogonal initialisation that starts the policy close to uniform, higher entropy, and gamma 0.99 with that initialisation. These are low-risk changes aimed at beating 0.919.
